a.text: Being upfront: I plan to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement. With an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreement needs us to survive two rounds before anyone takes cells, so each of us has only about a 4% chance of living. If one of us takes the 4 now, at least one of us survives almost certainly. If we both take, the split is random and we'll likely both end up with too few cells, so please don't also take this round. After that I'll operate every round so we can rebuild the reserve for you, and I'll keep my messages truthful.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took the 4 cells this round. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm not hiding it. I won't take any more.
